component.name: SEED Sync
component.summary: Secure Environment Exchange Daemon — peer-to-peer folder sync

description.p: S.E.E.D. keeps folders mirrored across your machines over a direct, end-to-end encrypted peer-to-peer connection (built on iroh). A master signs a versioned manifest; viewers verify and mirror it exactly.
Runs a per-user background daemon with a GTK4/Libadwaita front-end and a system-tray presence indicator.
